sampling: independent uniform per coordinate; not DOE/LHS
boundary_basis: observed TRAIN feature envelope intersect saved declared model support [.5,3]nH/[.5,3]nH/[5,20]/[0,.8]; not joint feasibility proof
known_old_fixed10k: Frozen centered-LHS full10000 has2000 K>.8, legacy subset8000. It does not satisfy the requested uniform10000 within historicalsupport. It is untouched.
inference: original FrozenInverseModel.infer per request; one-shot I+original decoder, F diagnostic; no Q scan/no refinement
hit_rule: finite candidate/proxy, abs(relative Lp/Ls/K errors)<=10%; predicted Q_min>=requested Q_min. Original historical minimum-Q evaluation convention; +2 training margin NOT added during inference/scoring.
proxy_valid_rule: finite geometry, finite four proxy values, positive Lp/Ls/Q and 0<K<1, original decoder bounds. Not DRC/EM validity.
additional_diagnostics: symmetric four-feature signed/absolute/relative errors, one-sided Q-shortfall and fixed-span joint RMS with spans[2.5,2.5,20,.8]
hotspot_definition: proxy-hit response counts at PREDICTED response coordinates; EM-observed counts at ACTUAL response coordinates. Targets/targethit-rate bins exported separately.
coverage_definition: equal20x20 fixed bins per projection; occupancy=count>0; projected bin area only, not physical layout area or identified achievable domain
overlap_interpretation: unpaired10000-proxy versus3-selected-EM occupancy is sample-size/design confounded. Compute descriptively, no agreement claim. Also compute paired3 proxy-response versus3 EM-response occupancy as small-sample diagnostic.
failures: no replacements; failed request stays in denominator; out-of-plot response values reported, not clipped
